'''Rica''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. She was killed as she tried to warn other [[Miner/Legends|miners]] at the beginning of the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]].
